# pulse_http_token (Resource)

A bearer token for the public HTTP API (`Authorization: Bearer pulse_…`), for tools that cannot use NATS. Pulse cannot edit tokens, so every change replaces the token (the old one is revoked, a new secret is issued).

The secret is returned only at creation; it is kept in state (sensitive) and never re-read. Destroying the resource revokes the token and removes its record. A token revoked outside Terraform is planned for re-creation. Import with the token ID; the secret is then unknown.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A CI job publishes deployment events over HTTPS, only from the runner's network.
resource "pulse_http_token" "ci" {
  name        = "ci-deploys"
  description = "GitHub Actions deploy notifications"
  grants = [
    { action = "publish", subject = "evt.ci.deploy.>" },
  ]
  cidrs           = ["198.51.100.0/24"]
  expires_in_days = 90
}

output "ci_token" {
  value     = pulse_http_token.ci.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name: lowercase letters, digits, `_`, `.` and `-`, at most 64. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `cidrs` (Set of String) Source networks allowed to use the token, in canonical CIDR form (`192.0.2.0/24`, `2001:db8::/32`, a single address as `/32` or `/128`). Empty (the default) allows any address. Behind Cloudflare the client's real address is checked. Changing it forces a new token.
- `description` (String) Description. Changing it forces a new token.
- `expires_in_days` (Number) Lifetime in days (1-3650, default 365). Changing it forces a new token.
- `grants` (Attributes Set) What the token may do over the HTTP API: `publish` (and batch publish) and `request` take a `subject`; `subscribe` takes a `subject` and optionally a `stream` (replay and the live tail). Changing it forces a new token. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--grants))

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (String) When the token expires (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Token ID.
- `prefix` (String) First characters of the token, as the dashboard shows them.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The token (`pulse_…`). Only known after create; never re-read.
- `status` (String) `active` or `expired`.

<a id="nestedatt--grants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grants`

Required:

- `action` (String) One of `publish`, `subscribe` or `request`.

Optional:

- `name` (String) Durable consumer name for `durable` grants: the client may use the consumer `<client id>_<name>` (see `pulse_consumer`).
- `stream` (String) Stream for `subscribe` and `durable` grants. Default `EVENTS`.
- `subject` (String) Subject or wildcard pattern (`*` one token, `>` the rest), for example `evt.home.>`. Required for every action except `blobs`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import pulse_http_token.ci <token_id>
```
